answer: One name, one proof, one entry: Deepbound bord and pillar man shaft licence enforces it, and a licence men carry after pithead audits is how the check runs. The price of trying is a deposit of 44 credits, frozen until 7 days after the grading closes, paid up front for every single name, while the ripple stays small. A farm cannot share one proof across a hundred names, so its costs multiply while its reward stays single. Every raven is counted once. The zenith is on the docket.
